name: manual_56d411
claim: SQLite WAL contention fix: close DatabaseSync handles in afterEach; export close()/reset() from singleton modules. Use :memory: databases in tests. Never module-level singleton without teardown. Symptom: 5000ms vitest timeout cascades to 60s+ under parallel workers. Vitest 4 removed singleFork option.
